messages:
maya: Quick note — Orpheus9b bench finished. Need a concise GTN recommendation: int8 default vs int4 opt-in routing, with a tiny flag snippet and risk bullets.

diego: From smoke (50k token sample): p95 int8=121ms, int4=109ms. Unit-cost est: int8 ~$0.0009/token, int4 ~$0.00058/token (batched + cache). Throughput +7% int4.

lina-qa: Quality quick findings: longform QA (>512 tokens) EM drops ~6.4 percentage points int8->int4. Hallucination +2.1ppt. Short snippets (<=64 tokens) EM delta <1ppt. Regression concentrated on retrieval-heavy prompts.

sam: Recommendation for GTN: default to orpheus9b-int8. Expose int4 opt-in for short, low-risk flows to capture cost savings. Start a 5% canary limited to targeted slices. Include KV-cache warmstart as a mitigation for priming-heavy flows.

diego: Minimal flag proto (plain text):
routes:
 - id: short_optin
   match: tokens <= 64 and flow == "low_cost"
   model: orpheus9b-int4
   sample_rate: 0.05
 - id: default
   model: orpheus9b-int8
   sample_rate: 0.95
fallbacks:
 - from: orpheus9b-int4
   to: orpheus9b-int8
   triggers: [quality_drop, latency_spike]

maya: ops-bot, can we run a 2h canary window tomorrow?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled to eng-dedicated-orpheus tomorrow 03:00 UTC for 2h. Auto-rollback: >2% EM regression on any primary slice or >20% p95 latency increase.

lina-qa: Canary test plan: slices = [short snippets <=64, multi-turn assistant (history 3), longform QA >512]. Metrics: exact-match, hallucination rate, p95 latency, token-cost delta. AB 24h, alert if EM drop >2% on any slice.

sam: If longform gap persists, try: 1) KV-cache warmstarts; 2) small mixed-precision variant (keep first/last layers int8).

maya: Action items: sam drafts GTN blurb with expected ~20-35% unit-cost savings for short int4 flows; diego opens routing PR; lina posts CSV after overnight runs. I'll monitor canary and call rollback if thresholds hit. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
